In many countries it is illegal to record a conversation without the consent of the people being recorded. Laws differ from one place to another, and it is up to you to know and respect the rules that apply to you.
FossRec is a tool. You alone are responsible for how you use it. The developer accepts no liability for any misuse, or for any legal consequence of recordings made with this app.
I have read and understood. I will only record with the consent of the people concerned.
M4A (AAC, 192 kbps, 44.1 kHz). Plays everywhere and works with most speech-to-text tools.
Long recordings can be cut automatically into several files. The recording never stops: the next part starts right away, and the parts stay linked in your list.
Start a new part when a file reaches this size. Useful for tools limited to 100 MB.
Start a new part at a regular interval.
About %1$d min of audio per part
If both are enabled, the first limit reached applies.
Ask for your fingerprint, face or screen lock each time you open FossRec. Off by default. It locks again every time you leave the app.
Set up a fingerprint, face unlock or screen lock in your phone settings to use this option.
No internet permission, no account, no tracking. Recordings stay in the app\'s private storage on your device.
Auto follows your phone\'s light or dark mode (and your wallpaper colors on Android 12+).
Choose the language of the app, or follow your phone.
When you stop a recording, the list refreshes by itself and the new recording appears at the top.
Swipe a recording left or right to delete it. You always get a confirmation first.
Add the Mini widget (one button) or the Large widget (timer, pause and resume) from your launcher.
Recording people without their consent is illegal in many countries. Tap to read the full notice.

Recordings and settings are stored only in FossRec\'s private folder on your phone (Android/data/ch.nthnbch.fossrec). Other apps cannot read it, nothing is backed up or uploaded, and everything is deleted if you uninstall the app. Files are not encrypted: anyone who can unlock your phone and plug it into a computer can reach them.
No location, no device name, no recording date inside the audio files: they are erased when a recording is saved. Only the file name (which contains the date and time) remains.

Microphone: required to record. Notifications: only to show the recording in the notification bar with Pause and Stop buttons. If you refuse them, recording works exactly the same from the app and the widgets. That is all: no storage, location, contacts or internet access.
